entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: Underground kingdom of undead on the island of Urborg, once ruled by Lich Lord Dralnu, with inverted tower-stalactites over a glowing pit.

entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: Lich lord who ruled Vhelnish; slew the lich lady who reanimated him.

entities.name: Lich lady
entities.description: Lich who reanimated Dralnu and used the palace to display her collection of undead.

entities.name: Marivel
entities.description: Panther warrior who discovered Vhelnish and became a powerful necromancer and leader of Free Urborg.

entities.name: Free Urborg
entities.description: Resistance led by Marivel that used Vhelnish as a hideaway.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: Event after which Free Urborg used Vhelnish.

events.summary: Dralnu slays the lich lady who reanimated him and transforms her palace into a city.
events.quote: After he had slain her, Dralnu transformed it into an actual city

events.summary: Marivel discovers the lost city and learns from its ancient knowledge to become a powerful necromancer and leader of Free Urborg.
events.quote: she learned from its ancient knowledge to become one of Urborg's most powerful necromancers

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Free Urborg uses Vhelnish as a hideaway despite Urguros haunting it.
events.quote: Free Urborg used Vhelnish as a hideaway

relations.quote: once ruled by the Lich Lord Dralnu

relations.quote: the leader of the Free Urborg resistance
